tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Page ground (theme.py BG in dark; white-mode off-white in light). Sits under the orbs and every glass layer.

tokens.name: orb-1
tokens.usage: Blue light orb, top-left of the page ground: a radial gradient from orb-1 to transparent over ~60% of the viewport width. Paint on the ground only, never on glass.

tokens.name: orb-2
tokens.usage: Violet orb, top-right, same recipe. Keep orbs behind glass so blur picks up a soft colour.

tokens.name: orb-3
tokens.usage: Teal orb, bottom-right, same recipe.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Widget and panel fill, always with backdrop-blur (blur-md) and glass-border. Text on it: text-strong, text, text-muted, ok, error, warn, info (checked over every orb).

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, menus, toasts, pills and the tab bar: a denser glass with blur-lg (blur-sm for pills).

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge around every glass layer.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Inset 1px top highlight on glass (inset 0 1px 0), the light-catching edge.

tokens.name: field-fill
tokens.usage: Input background inside glass. Text on it: text-strong, text-muted.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind a Sheet or ConfirmDialog.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Opaque fallback for field-fill and the tab strip (theme.py TABS_BG).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque fallback for glass-fill when backdrop blur is unavailable, and tiles inside a glass widget. Text on it: text-strong, text, text-muted, ok, error, warn.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Segmented-control tracks and inner tiles on glass. Use text-strong, text or text-muted on it; error text is below 4.5:1 here in dark, so use it on glass or surface only.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of surface-raised controls.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input outlines and focus-adjacent edges, 3:1 or better on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, hero amounts, merchant and field names on bg-base, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and table values (theme.py TEXT) on bg-base, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: column headers, dates, hints, nav labels on bg-base, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the single primary button per view. Pair with on-action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success state, positive LEFT or REST and the toast check (theme.py OK). On bg-base, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Negative amounts, overspend and field validation messages (theme.py ERROR). On bg-base, surface, surface-sunken only; always with a minus sign or a written message.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings, the negative-REST chip and the close-month confirmation note (theme.py WARN). Pair with a word or the warning glyph.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notes, the focus ring and links (theme.py INFO). On bg-base, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Label on a filled ok, warn, info or section-accent chip.

tokens.name: income-accent
tokens.usage: The income row's accent (theme.py INCOME_ACCENT); used nowhere else.

tokens.name: section-1
tokens.usage: Section accent 1, gold (theme.py SECTION_PALETTE). Assigned to sections in order; bar, name and avatar fill.

tokens.name: section-2
tokens.usage: Section accent 2, blue.

tokens.name: section-3
tokens.usage: Section accent 3, magenta.

tokens.name: section-4
tokens.usage: Section accent 4, green.

tokens.name: section-5
tokens.usage: Section accent 5, cyan.

tokens.name: section-6
tokens.usage: Section accent 6, amber.

tokens.name: section-7
tokens.usage: Section accent 7, azure.

tokens.name: section-8
tokens.usage: Section accent 8, red. Then cycle from section-1.

tokens.name: col-budget
tokens.usage: Budget column values in the field table (theme.py COLUMN_COLORS).

tokens.name: col-paid
tokens.usage: Paid column values and the transaction Amount column.

tokens.name: col-dim
tokens.usage: Max and Pocket columns. In dark this is 4.5:1 on surface (source value kept); use text-muted for anything smaller than 13px.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical chart slot 1 (blue). Use for non-section dimensions (pockets, payees, months); sections keep their own section-N accents. Assign in order, never cycle. Validated on glass in both modes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 (orange).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 (aqua).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 (yellow). Below 3:1 on white glass in light mode: always label directly or provide the table view.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 (magenta). Same light-mode label rule.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 (green).

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7 (violet).

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8 (red). Token ceiling: fold anything past 8 into Other.

tokens.name: chart-income
tokens.usage: Income and money-in lines and bars. Always labelled Income; differs from chart-spent by label and line style, never hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-spent
tokens.usage: Spent and money-out lines and bars. Always labelled Spent.

tokens.name: chart-budget
tokens.usage: Budget pace and limit lines (dashed) and sparkline strokes.

tokens.name: chart-forecast
tokens.usage: Forecast line (dotted), continuing from today.

tokens.name: chart-last
tokens.usage: Previous-period comparison line (thin, solid).

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: 1px hairline gridlines. Solid, recessive.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Baseline, axes, future-day outlines.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of meters, gauges and donut base.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Heatmap cell with zero spend.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Sequential blue, lowest non-zero. More is lighter in dark, darker in light.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Sequential highest.

tokens.name: div-over-2
tokens.usage: Diverging pole: over budget (warm). Always labelled 'over'.

tokens.name: div-over-1
tokens.usage: Diverging light step over.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging neutral midpoint; never a hue.

tokens.name: div-under-1
tokens.usage: Diverging light step under.

tokens.name: div-under-2
tokens.usage: Diverging pole: under budget (cool). Always labelled 'under'.

tokens.name: heat-ink-1
tokens.usage: Day number on heat-1 cells in the HeatmapCalendar (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: heat-ink-2
tokens.usage: Day number on heat-2 cells in the HeatmapCalendar (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: heat-ink-3
tokens.usage: Day number on heat-3 cells in the HeatmapCalendar (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: heat-ink-4
tokens.usage: Day number on heat-4 cells in the HeatmapCalendar (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: heat-ink-5
tokens.usage: Day number on heat-5 cells in the HeatmapCalendar (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: brand-mint
tokens.usage: Logo only: wordmark on ink, and the app icon tile on light surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Logo only: app icon tile and wordmark letters in white mode.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one hero amount per page (income or post pool); decimals set in hero-cents.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Table and row amounts; always right-aligned with tabular figures.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, kind and share (post · 50%), routing, in text-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase column headers (SECTIONS, AVAIL, REST) and nav labels.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text typed into a TextField. 16px minimum so mobile browsers don't zoom on focus.

styles.name: field-error
styles.usage: Validation message under a field, in error.

styles.name: chart-tick
styles.usage: Axis ticks and category labels in text-muted.

styles.name: chart-label
styles.usage: Direct labels at a line end or bar tip, in text (never the series colour).

styles.name: tooltip-value
styles.usage: Value in a tooltip row; the series name follows in text-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside pills and between pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row gap; gap between a field label and its input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between widgets; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Widget padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop page margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles inside a widget, menus and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Widgets, panels, dialogs and mobile bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs, bars, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Resting glass widgets and the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs and the floating add button.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, toasts.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Widgets and panels (glass-fill). Add saturate(140%).

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, menus and the tab bar (glass-strong).

tokens.name: line-width
tokens.usage: Line series stroke, round caps and joins.

tokens.name: line-width-thin
tokens.usage: Gridlines, previous-period line.

tokens.name: marker-size
tokens.usage: End dots (r 4) with a 2px surface ring.

tokens.name: bar-max
tokens.usage: Maximum column thickness; 4px rounded data-end, square at the baseline.

tokens.name: bar-radius
tokens.usage: Rounded data-end of bars and columns.

tokens.name: mark-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between touching marks (stack segments, adjacent bars, donut slices uses 3px arc gap).

tokens.name: area-opacity
tokens.usage: Area wash under a line.
